spans.text: Demoknights are hellish constructs that can be created in a number of ways - they can be fiendish armor infused with a soul stolen by a devil, or a form taken by a fiend that has been reduced to a mere footsoldier by its master. Demoknights are as much constructs as they are fiends, though their bodies are made of soldier metal and stone. They have reduced mental abilities and their bodies are fragile as a consequence of their creation, but they are ruthless and bloodthirsty. They can be created from lesser devils by masters who need an army of steel at a moment’s notice.

It is also possible for demoknights to be created by arcanists who dabble in twisted fusions of transmutation and daemoturgy, fusing living flesh and bound souls into metal against its will to form a compliant and obedient soldier. When created this way, however, they are filled with the rage of those who were forcefully imbued into their metal husks, and have a growing bloodlust that must be sated lest it turn on its master.
